sources.title: Chad
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: Bulgaria's live MFA travel-information page, last updated 15 October 2025, directly selects an ordinary Bulgarian passport as visa-required and says Bulgarian citizens need a Chad visa. It supplies the nationality-specific non-exempt premise, while Chad's newer authority controls issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Пътуващите за Чад български граждани се нуждаят от виза.

sources.title: New visa tariffs in the Republic of Chad
sources.publisher: Directorate of Immigration and Emigration, Republic of Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: The live evisa.td notice identifies the Directorate of Immigration and Emigration and its eVisa subdirectorate. It requires all new non-diplomatic and non-courtesy visa applications exclusively through evisa.td from 11 May 2026, superseding old mission-filing instructions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: toutes les demandes de visa se font désormais exclusivement en ligne via plateforme officielle evisa.td.

sources.title: E-Visa circular
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration / E-Visa Subdirectorate
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 4 June 2026 official circular gives electronic-visa processing periods, confirming a pre-travel electronic route rather than an arrival-issued instrument.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Demande de e-Visa standard : 10 jours ouvrables; Demande de e-Visa express: 72 heures

sources.title: Comoros
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: Bulgaria's live MFA travel-information page, last updated 15 October 2025, directly marks the ordinary Bulgarian passport as visa-required and states that Bulgarian travellers obtain the visa at the Comorian Embassy in Paris.
sources.supportingExcerpt: се нуждаят от виза за престой до 90 дни, която могат да получат в посолството на Коморите в Париж.

sources.title: Iran
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: Bulgaria's live MFA Iran guidance directly says Bulgarian travellers first complete an e-visa application but receive the visa at Iran's Embassy in Sofia. The electronic form therefore does not normalize as an electronically issued visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Визата се получава от посолството на Иран в София.

sources.title: Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: Bulgaria's live MFA Sudan page, last updated 6 August 2025, marks the ordinary Bulgarian passport as visa-required and identifies Sudan's Bucharest Embassy as the application point. The page also records severe security risk and no functioning Bulgarian embassy in Khartoum.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Българските граждани могат да кандидатстват за визи в посолството на Судан в Букурещ.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgaria's MFA directly requires a Chad visa for ordinary Bulgarian passports, and Chad's current immigration authority requires all new non-diplomatic visa applications exclusively through evisa.td.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Bulgarian-passport short visitors, which Bulgaria's MFA directly identifies as visa-required.
Submit the new visa request exclusively through evisa.td before travel; standard eVisa processing is 10 working days and express processing is 72 hours.
Purpose, processing, security, duration, final admission, work, residence, transit, official, diplomatic and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

application.label: Chad official eVisa application
steps: Submit the new visitor-visa request through evisa.td before travel.
Complete the electronic application and any requested immigration checks.
Travel only with the approved visa and required admission documents.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Union of the Comoros advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgaria's MFA directly requires a visa for ordinary Bulgarian passports and says Bulgarian visitors can obtain it at the Comorian Embassy in Paris for stays up to 90 days.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Bulgarian-passport visitors for stays up to 90 days.
Obtain the visa at the Comorian Embassy in Paris before travel; later extension after entry does not change this baseline.
Passport validity, purpose, documents, final admission, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Iran advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgaria's MFA says Bulgarian visitors first complete an electronic visa application but receive the visa at Iran's Embassy in Sofia, making this an advance mission-visa route.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Bulgarian passports; Bulgarian diplomatic and official passport exemptions are outside scope.
Complete the electronic visa application, then receive the visa at Iran's Embassy in Sofia before travel. The online form does not itself issue an eVisa.
Purpose, Iranian dual nationality, passport-marking restrictions, security, final admission, transit, work, residence and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgaria's MFA directly marks ordinary Bulgarian passports visa-required and identifies Sudan's Bucharest Embassy for visa applications.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Bulgarian-passport short visitors.
Apply through Sudan's Embassy in Bucharest before travel.
Severe security risk, mission availability, final admission, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

conflicts.explanation: Bulgaria's MFA directly requires a Chad visa for ordinary Bulgarian passports, while Chad's current authority requires every new non-diplomatic visa application through evisa.td.
Bulgaria's MFA directly says ordinary Bulgarian travellers obtain the Comorian visa at the Embassy in Paris before travel.
Bulgaria's MFA says the visa is received at Iran's Embassy in Sofia after electronic application, not issued at the border.
